title: CubeDupe
description: A duping server with custom abilities, items, ranks and lots of commands. (Season 3)
body:
**🧊 CubeDupe is a duping server with skills, relics, teams, sword abilities, daily & weekly rewards, phases and useful commands like /tpa.**
**❓ Why should I join?** I think I did the ranks good and especially the systems like skills I mean I personally think they're very cool
**🦴 What to expect** The server has almost everything written in Skript, including mechanics similar to: - mcMMO - SimpleTeams - EssentialsX - AmbientSounds *(only a little)* It also has quite good specs, like RAM, etc.
Of course no client side mods are required (only a server resource pack that you don't need to download manually).
**⏳ Version support** The server supports a wide range of versions ending at around ~1.9, however using those older versions is heavily unrecommended. They may flag the anticheat, not work with custom content and not display text correctly.
